name: The Final Day of Spring
source:
In a world where magic is an almost uncontrollable energy that everyone eventually loses, Elishe's life was changed by this power when she was just a teenager. Although she possessed magic only for a brief period of time, she realized to what extent the nature around her was alive.

Decades later, when her life was about to end, magic came to her once again, but through a curse. The power in her veins expanded her life, but she lost her happiness. One day, she made a decision...

[From [url=https://chihirchan.itch.io/the-final-day-of-spring]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个魔法是一种几乎无法控制的能量、每个人最终都会失去的世界里，艾莉舍的生活在她十几岁的时候就被这种力量改变了。虽然她只拥有了短暂的魔法，但她意识到她周围的自然有多么活跃。

几十年后，当她的生命即将结束时，魔法再次降临到她身上，但却是通过诅咒。她血管里的力量扩大了她的生命，但她却失去了幸福。有一天，她做了一个决定……

[来自[url=https://chihirchan.itch.io/the-final-day-of-spring]Itch.io[/url]]
